# Ninja Tournament — Open-Source Fan Remake

> Unofficial clean-room, open-source 3D browser fan remake inspired by the discontinued 2015 LEGO Ninjago Tournament mobile arena game. The current build has 51 playable fighters and is maintained by Youssef Fekry.

The canonical website is https://lego-ninjago-tournament.pages.dev/. The project is not an official LEGO release and is not affiliated with or endorsed by LEGO, TT Games, Hellbent Games or other rights holders. Original project code and original project materials use the MIT License; third-party intellectual property is excluded.

## Primary resources

- [Homepage Markdown](https://lego-ninjago-tournament.pages.dev/index.md): Concise canonical description, current features, technology and project status.
- [About and FAQ Markdown](https://lego-ninjago-tournament.pages.dev/about.md): Detailed project overview, clean-room policy, licensing and frequently asked questions.
- [Canonical project facts](https://lego-ninjago-tournament.pages.dev/project-facts.json): Machine-readable facts about the game, features, technology, license and affiliation.
- [Human-readable About page](https://lego-ninjago-tournament.pages.dev/about.html): Crawlable HTML project overview and FAQ.
